H2_calibration.quote: Courts may also read exemptions narrowly in light of statutory purpose. These readings are better treated as evidence of poor drafting than as an operating plan

H1_holdback.quote: Items marked (L) are gaps that, if raised publicly, sponsors can close with a manager's amendment. This is especially true of items 1, 9–11, 13, 18, and 22. The legal team may want to separate gaps worth flagging publicly from those to keep internal.
